title: FarsBase: The First Persian Knowledge Graph
lead: Majid Asgari-Bidhendi, Ali Hadian, Prof. Behrouz Minaei-Bidgoli
description: FarsBase is the pioneering multi-source, cross-domain Persian knowledge base containing over 100M RDF triples. It extracts facts from Persian Wikipedia and web sources, providing entity linking and SPARQL endpoints used in domestic search engines.

title: FAIR-RAG & FARSIQA
lead: Mohammad Aghajani Asl, Majid Asgari-Bidhendi, Prof. Behrouz Minaei-Bidgoli
description: Faithful Adaptive Iterative Refinement for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Developed to enforce rigorous source fidelity and citation provenance in complex, specialized QA domains, eliminating hallucination via multi-stage verification.

title: PersianMHQA & Bactrainus
lead: Mobina Taji, Iman Barati, Arash Ghafouri, Prof. Behrouz Minaei-Bidgoli
description: The first comprehensive open-domain Persian multi-hop question answering benchmark with explicit reasoning paths, paired with Bactrainus: an optimized parameter-efficient LLM framework for compositional question answering.

title: Rezwan: 1.2M Corpus & LLM Pipeline for Classical Arabic/Persian
lead: Majid Asgari-Bidhendi, M. Amin Ghaseminia, Alireza Shahbazi, Prof. Behrouz Minaei-Bidgoli
description: An ambitious computational linguistics and digital humanities initiative curating a 1.2M narrative corpus with chain-of-narration extraction, entity recognition, and semantic validation through tailored large language models.

title: Persian NLP Benchmark Suite (Pars-ABSA, Pars-OFF, ParsFEVER)
lead: Kamyar Darvishi, Taha Shangipour, Majid Zarharan, Prof. Behrouz Minaei-Bidgoli
description: A foundational suite of high-quality annotated corpora for low-resource Persian language processing, spanning aspect-based sentiment analysis, offensive language detection, and automated claim verification.

title: Borhan: Non-Monotonic Default Logic Engine
lead: Alireza Shahbazi, Mohammad Hossein Khojasteh, Prof. Behrouz Minaei-Bidgoli
description: A high-performance automated reasoner designed for prioritized default logic, enabling neural-symbolic systems to handle exceptions, conflicting rules, and hierarchical legal/domain norms.

title: Ball*-tree & ROLL: Large-Scale Scale-Free Graph Synthesis
description: High-throughput algorithms and in-memory synthesis structures (Ball*-tree and ROLL) for massive scale-free network generation and graph analytics, published in ACM SIGMOD and IEEE TKDE.

title: Virastyar: Persian Spell-Checker & Text Processing Engine
lead: DML Natural Language Processing Research Team
description: One of the earliest comprehensive open-source Persian spell-checking and morphological correction engines, integrating dictionary lookup, heuristic n-gram correction, and half-space standardization used across academic and enterprise software.
